title: Copilot Studio: Review panel shows agent readiness and policy blocks while building
summary: Hold: the automation listed for blocking connectors only reads policies and cannot apply the restriction. Licensing is also incorrectly marked unpublished even though Microsoft documents access and usage-based billing for the harness. The roadmap details and the description of Review are supported.

claims.fix: Set licensing.model to consumption. Replace the notes with: 'The Microsoft Copilot harness uses usage-based billing measured in Copilot Credits. A missing panel-specific licence does not make the documented product entitlement unknown.

claims.claim: Get-DlpPolicy -PolicyName <policy name> is the automation counterpart to the row's control over permitted or blocked capabilities.
claims.quote: Retrieves a list of DLP policy objects. ... The Get-DlpPolicy cmdlet retrieves policy objects for the logged in admin's tenant.
claims.fix: Replace the read-only call with 'Set-DlpPolicy -PolicyName <policy name> -UpdatedPolicy <DLPPolicyDefinition object>' and set its docs to https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/module/microsoft.powerapps.administration.powershell/set-dlppolicy?view=pa-ps-latest, which documents updating the policy through UpdatedPolicy. Replace the row note with 'General control that Review reports on. UpdatedPolicy supplies the updated DLPPolicyDefinition object.' Keep Get-DlpPolicy, if mentioned, only as a read-only inventory operation, not as the operation that applies the control.
